arguments.command:
cd /workspace/task && md5sum scratch/tags.json && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
src='scratch/tags.json'
data=json.load(open(src,encoding='utf-8'))
seen=set(); out=[]
for s in data:
    t=s.strip()
    if not t or t in seen: continue
    seen.add(t); out.append(t)
with open('scratch/tags-clean.json','w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(out,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
print(out)
EOF
md5sum scratch/tags.json && cat scratch/tags-clean.json
